audience: teams who share schedules, rooms and resources on a Teamup Calendar

useCases.title: See what is on the calendar for a date range
useCases.text: The AI lists events in a date range, optionally for some sub-calendars, with recurring events expanded into each occurrence, so you see the week day by day.

useCases.title: Find events that mention a keyword
useCases.text: The AI searches events by keyword within a date range you choose and opens one event for its location, notes, signups and change history.

useCases.title: See who signed up for an event
useCases.text: The AI lists the people signed up for an event, with name and email, when signups are enabled on it.

useCases.title: List sub-calendars for people, rooms or resources
useCases.text: The AI lists the sub-calendars with their colors and active state, and opens one to show its overlap rule.

useCases.title: Add an event to the shared calendar
useCases.text: The AI creates an event on a sub-calendar with start and end time. You can undo the creation within one hour.

useCases.title: Change or delete an event
useCases.text: The AI changes fields of an event, or of one occurrence of a recurring event, or deletes it. Deletions can be undone within one hour.
